label: copy phase of very short (L=3) sequences, plus L=4 second-to-last output for certain inputs
explanation: Active only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on the <DEL> step), and only on repeated-token inputs (in_first=0). Strongest by far in L=3 sequences: fires on ~90% of their copy steps (t=4,5), with the top activations at t=5 (second copy input, outputting the final token, i.e. two steps after <DEL>); about 60% of activation mass. Second component: L=4 sequences at step 6 (to_go=1, input orig(1)), where it fires on about 25% of steps, mostly when the input is one of o, a, y, r, d, p, k, u. A weaker tail sits near the end of longer sequences (e.g. the last step of L=9, t=17), and this predicate does not capture it. It is nearly silent mid-copy in longer sequences (L>=5). Magnitude is largest in L=3 at the second copy step. Dev F1 0.67, mass recall 0.80, precision 0.81.
